summary: Clean pass. All four re-touch fixes landed and verify at pixel level. Fig 2 band 1: 'Markdown · YAML' chip right border at x=1944 vs band border at x=1971 (27 px physical = ~13.5 logical px at the 2x render), matching the (a) row's rightmost chip (same 27 px) and band 1's own left padding (27 px) — symmetric and consistent. Fig 2 band (b): 'Rewrite query' chip left border at x=55-56, pixel-identical to 'Prepared PDF pool' above; legend zooms to exactly 'dashed outline = the fallback path'. Fig 2 badges: all three boxes are 52 px physical tall with equal ~12 px gaps and identical x-extents (56-1943); the dashed outlines read 2 px taller only because the stroke is centered on the same box edge. Fig 3: all five excerpts (BQ04 A/B/C, BQ06 A/C) open with curly quote + leading ellipsis; BQ04 A and BQ06 A close with trailing ellipsis + curly quote, BQ04 B and BQ06 C close as complete sentences with period + curly quote, BQ04 C nests an inner quote then ellipsis + curly close — outer delimiters all correct and no text touches any card border (tightest: 18 px side clearance in BQ04 A, 16 px bottom clearance in BQ06 C, both at designed padding). Full-page pass over pages 1-5 is clean: figures sit on pp. 2/3/4 in reading order, captions in main.tex match the rendered figures (including 'dashed outlines mark the fallback path' in the Fig 2 caption), Table 1 and the monitored-run strip are aligned, page 5 disclosure and references are tidy. Author placeholders on page 1 are the declared single-blind draft placeholders, not an oversight. One P2 polish remains: inner quotation marks inside the BQ04 C excerpt and the BQ06 C 'Closest chunk' snippet are straight (") while the excerpt delimiters are curly.
